sect2.para: rustc cargo-c cosmic-icons pulseaudio pipewire dbus libxkbcommon libinput

sect2.title: Installation of Cosmic-applets

screen.userinput:
install -vDm755 target/release/cosmic-applets /usr/bin/cosmic-applets &&
install -vDm644 cosmic-applet-status-area/data/com.system76.CosmicStatusNotifierWatcher.service \ /usr/lib/systemd/user/com.system76.CosmicStatusNotifierWatcher.service &&
install -vDm644 cosmic-applet-status-area/data/dbus-1/com.system76.CosmicStatusNotifierWatcher.service \ /usr/share/dbus-1/services/com.system76.CosmicStatusNotifierWatcher.service &&
install -vDm644 data/com.system76.CosmicApplets.metainfo.xml /usr/share/metainfo &&
cp -rv cosmic-app-list/data/default_schema/* /usr/share/cosmic/

sect2.para: Now, as the root user, create the symlinks to the multicall binary, install the icons, and install the desktop files:

screen.userinput:
for applet in cosmic-app-list cosmic-applet-a11y cosmic-applet-audio \ cosmic-applet-battery cosmic-applet-bluetooth \ cosmic-applet-input-sources cosmic-applet-minimize \ cosmic-applet-network cosmic-applet-notifications \ cosmic-applet-osk cosmic-applet-power \ cosmic-applet-status-area cosmic-applet-tiling \ cosmic-applet-time cosmic-applet-workspaces \ cosmic-panel-button do ln -sfrv /usr/bin/cosmic-applets /usr/bin/$applet done
for dir in cosmic-app-list cosmic-applet-a11y cosmic-applet-audio \ cosmic-applet-battery cosmic-applet-bluetooth \ cosmic-applet-input-sources cosmic-applet-minimize \ cosmic-applet-network cosmic-applet-notifications \ cosmic-applet-osk cosmic-applet-power \ cosmic-applet-status-area cosmic-applet-tiling \ cosmic-applet-time cosmic-applet-workspaces \ cosmic-panel-app-button cosmic-panel-launcher-button \ cosmic-panel-workspaces-button do if [ -d $dir/data/icons ]; then cp -rv $dir/data/icons/* /usr/share/icons/hicolor fi done
